name: sceGuAlphaFunc
comment: Emits GE command 0xDB (alpha test): function | reference << 8 | mask << 16.

name: scalar_approach
type: void scalar_approach(float target, float rate, float *value)
comment: Proportional approach value += (target-value)*rate when different; effect_screen_blur_update type6 uses gain1/lifetime to approach scale1,turn0,RGB128 and alpha0. Alpha is converted to integer and repacked after every update.

name: random_inclusive
comment: Random integer 0..maximum inclusive.

name: projectile_context_begin
comment: Clamps the percentage 0..100 into context +0xE8 and the low 24 colour bits into +0xEC, as NA2's 0x0010D220.

name: projectile_context_end
comment: Clears context +0xE8, as NA2's 0x0010D200.

name: material_set_alpha_test
comment: Alpha test greater than the texture's cutoff (runtime texture +0x10, the archive's +0x17) times the material alpha; failing texels are discarded.

name: model_submit_ordinary
comment: Ordinary model submission. Iterate part table at model+18 forward by50 bytes through u16 part_count+26, compile each draw into current PSP list; direct/ordered selection uses material*context alpha below127/128, model draw-state bit3 or texture flags+4 bit8. Both lists retain forward material-part order. Unlike NA2 model_dispatch_geometry, no head-prepending/reversal of material parts; partial-alpha floor decals can therefore depend on earlier opaque ground parts.

name: material_apply_draw_state
comment: Per material: colour with material alpha; untextured: alpha test greater than 0; textured: binds texture and palette, alpha test always when model flag +0x180 bit 3, else material_set_alpha_test.

name: scene_object_unregister_environments
comment: For each child: objects (0x100) recurse through 0x0889021C; models (0x800) with collision (+0x38) unregister it (0x088C3EF0).

name: gu_alpha_func_mapped
comment: sceGuAlphaFunc with the function mapped through 0x08B35DCC (identity: 1 always, 6 greater).

name: ccs_expand_vertex_colour
comment: Expand each packed RGBA byte c to max(2*c-1,0), with no upper clamp before packed OR. Used by ordinary geometry list compilation; RGB above128 spills into adjacent channels.

name: model_compile_ordinary_mesh
comment: Compile retained ordinary arrays into PSP vertex layouts based on model flags, signed short XYZ*position scale, optional normal bytes, expanded RGBA through ccs_expand_vertex_colour and UV/256. Split triangle-strip runs using normal/control fourth byte, recording sceGuDrawArray lists. This preserves vertex/strip order inside a material part.

name: ccs_parse_palette
comment: Read CLUT section, retaining RGB bytes and expanding every alpha a to max(2*a-1,0). 16 entries use palette format14, larger13. Palette data does not brighten RGB; partial-alpha rock shadow TEX_s10obj19 in s10 has RGB101319, alpha up to4A authored (147 expanded).

name: mission_apply_battle_record
comment: Reads a 0x52-byte eventBattle.ccbpm record; scene halfword at +0x2A.

name: bg_control_get_active
comment: The active background control (sections of 0x150 bytes; +0x14 section count; +0x600 player positions).

name: stage_format_archive_path
comment: Formats the stage folder prefix and the scene's archive name.

name: bg_control_load_scene
comment: Loads the scene archive and BIN_bgdata, builds player positions, safe position, change lines and section lines from markers, constructs the scenes, loads DMY_cpmin/cpmax/cvmin/cvmax camera bounds.

name: bg_resolve_section_transfer
comment: NA2's stage_resolve_boundary: maps x over variant 0's first and last nodes (+0xC0/+0xD0), then projects onto the target section's active-variant lines (+0xF8 + 0x10 x variant +0xF0); the only reader of the variant.

name: bg_clamp_to_section_extremes
comment: Clamps x to the section's +0x90/+0xA0, the x extremes of every variant's DMY_line nodes; returns 0 when clamped. NA2's stage_clamp_section_endpoints uses DMY_linemin/max.

name: bg_floor_profile
comment: Lowest height over the section's selected floor-segment list (+0x180, selector byte +0x17C, never changed) and its change-line list (+0x13C, selector +0x138); -32768 without one.

name: bg_build_change_lines
comment: Reads DMY_<f|b>[n]_cl_<k>_nor/end/mov pairs as typed lines per section, as NA2's first-family lines.

name: bg_build_section_lines
comment: For sections 1..4 reads DMY_line_0n0 marker pairs (stem, stem_1, stem_2..; up to 32 pairs; variants stem1..3) as floor segments and walkable lines; DMY_linemin/max0n bound each section.

name: bg_load_player_positions
comment: DMY_pp1_010..DMY_pp9_010 into bg +0x600, zero when absent.

name: bg_control_load_safe_position
comment: DMY_safe_pos into bg +0x6A0, (0,0,0,1) when absent.

name: bg_break_initialize
comment: Clears the break state; break sound 0x3A at note 0x40.

name: bg_break_trigger
comment: Factory 50 hit: removes the current piece's collision, advances; on the final hit plays its sound (+0x75C, default 0x3A) at its note (+0x760, default 0x40) at the hit node and drops items.

name: bg_break_anm_trigger
comment: Factory 102 hit; the final one plays sound 0x38 on scene 0 only, then 0x3A, centred, and drops items.

name: bg_break_doll_update
comment: Factory 41: each hit resets the doll's cycle and drops items; no sound.

name: bg_landing_tree_queue_impulse
comment: Factory-48 reaction helper: queue -50 at +0x60; when current impulse +0x64 is zero, start it and clear the queue; copy tree height +0x58 to displacement height +0x78. Spawns no surface effects or sound.

name: bg_landing_tree_reaction
comment: Factory 48, four fighters: starts the displacement as NA2's; on a grounded reaction (majors 0/1, also after 8 grounded updates) plays sound 0x50 at the fighter; no surface effect.

name: bg_crash_break_update
comment: Factory 55: fighters on its section (+0x754) trigger it; the final break hides its models, calls 0x0893AA70(fighter +0x33C4, 0x1B, 1) and advances the section's line variant (+0xF0 = (+0xF0 + 1) % +0xF4).

name: bg_crash_break_reborn_parse
comment: Factory 134: bomb, second object or 0, spot stem (<stem>_a<n>, up to 8), blast radius, away updates (90), fuse updates (150).

name: bg_crash_break_reborn_update
comment: States: 1 fuse (red pulse, last 15% blink and swell to 2), 2 blast (16 updates of hits within the radius), 3 away hidden 200 below a random spot, 4 rise over 30; holds while stage updates are restricted.

name: bg_crash_break_reborn_draw
comment: Rising: plain; fuse: tinted red by sin(angle) x 50 percent through projectile_context_begin.

name: bg_crash_break_reborn_blast
comment: Play effect0x ANM_e0x_bom0 jittered +-10 and turned randomly on z; set effect flags byte+20 bit0 for camera-facing animation. Type6 screen blur from time_bomb_blur_parameters08B39190:scale1.1,turn0,colour50808080,lifetime20,alpha toward0;record+1C pi/16 is phase increment unused bykind0. Play positional sound1011 at bomb+30 from battleSE program11/VAG20.

name: bg_flicker_object_update
comment: Every 30 updates starts a flicker with chance/3001; toggles opacity 0/1 each update for 2..4 updates, then 1.

name: bg_flicker_object_parse
comment: Factory 135: object, marker or 0, flicker chance in 3001.

name: bg_factory_fog
comment: Factory 10: RGB, near/far percentages, near/far distances, NA2's tokens.

name: bg_factory_render_coefficients
comment: Factory 17: first token to 0x08CDDA48, second to 0x08CDDA44.

name: stage_select_build_available_list
comment: Scans the 13 Stage Select rows in order, keeping scenes whose availability bit is set.

name: camera_track_stage
comment: Normal-stage camera: frames the fighters by mode, clamps to the stage markers (0x089599F0), eases eye and target by 0.3 per update.

name: camera_follow_behind_fighter
comment: Mode 1: eye behind the tracked fighter on the line to its opponent, (2 + 0.001 d) of the half-span out, raised by a fifth of its depth and 100, at least 50 above the fighter.

name: camera_frame_fighter_box_same_section
comment: Mode 3: target = active fighters' box centre + (0,0,100); eye = target - (0,d,-0.11d), d = max(600, 1.44 x box diagonal).

name: camera_frame_fighter_box
comment: Mode 0: target = active fighters' box centre + (0,0,75); eye = target - (0,d,-0.22d), d = max(800, 2 x box diagonal).

name: mission_top_level_camera_track
comment: Scene 35 (r023) camera with fixed bounds 0x08B47AF0.

name: camera_select_stage_mode
comment: Per update, by the opponents on the tracked fighter's section: none 0; several, or one while it is not in major state 8, 3; in major 8 within 1000 of its one opponent, or that opponent in major 5, 1.

name: camera_clamp_to_stage_bounds
comment: Clamps the eye per axis to bg +0x6B0/+0x6C0 (DMY_cpmin/cpmax), moving it back by any lateral overshoot, and the target to +0x6D0/+0x6E0 (DMY_cvmin/cvmax).

name: mission_camera_track
comment: Mission camera from six scene-minus-13 vector tables at 0x08B47B90..0x08B484A0; eases 0.2.

name: battle_camera_update_by_scene_kind
comment: Normal scenes 0x08958724; mission scene 35 0x089592C4; other missions 0x08959B74.

name: stage_get_name_text
comment: Resolves the scene's name text entry.

name: ai_controller_bind
comment: Binds a controller to its fighter: sorts the other fighters into allies and enemies by team (+0x70 & 3), a random 0..30 timer, and on mission scenes the archive's BIN_cpucooproutetbl.

name: ai_controller_update
comment: Per tick: targets the manager's first fighter among its allies or enemies, faces it on the same section, chooses the next state, switches to it when the timer runs out and runs the current state.

name: ai_choose_state_alternate
comment: ai_choose_state's choices for fighters 0x089C18E4 selects; like it, steps toward the target's section, and may change to a random one of the stage's sections (background +0x14): 0xD when below the fighter's, else 0xC.

name: ai_choose_close_state
comment: Close-range choices; may change to a random one of the stage's sections (background +0x14) as ai_choose_state_section_aware does.

name: ai_choose_state
comment: On another section than its target's: attack, or step toward the target's section (state 0xC up, 0xD down); on the same section, choices by distance. No section x range is read.

name: ai_enter_state
comment: Sets the controller's current state (+0x1C4) and clears the next (+0x1C8).

name: ai_set_next_state
comment: Sets the controller's next state (+0x1C8).

name: ai_state_approach_target
comment: On the target's section, moves toward it by x (output bits 1 right, 2 left); otherwise sets state 0xC or 0xD toward the target's section, then 9.

name: ai_controllers_bind_all
comment: ai_controller_bind for each of the four controllers and the manager's fighters.

name: effect_scene_update
comment: Effect scene movement,scale,fade,lifetime and bound-player update. Flags byte+20 bit0 chooses camera-facing matrix: scale,local Z/Y/X rotation,active camera renderer+10 matrix then transpose,restore world translation+30; clearbit uses world transform. Bind via embedded interface+100,update and publish opacity; return completion.

name: effect_screen_blur_configure
comment: Copy type+0,kind+4,scale+8,turn+C,colour+10,duration+14,phase+18,phase_increment+1C into runtime48/4C/60/64/68/50-52/58/5C. Type6 initial scale1.1,turn0,colour50808080,gain1/20; +1C is phase increment, not turn.

name: effect_screen_blur_update
comment: Lifetime short+52; return1 once zero,otherwise dispatch type+48 then decrement positive lifetime. Type6 scalar_approach scale+60 toward1 and turn+64 toward0 with gain+54; RGB toward128 and alpha toward0. Kind+4C selects optional extra position/scale behavior.

name: effect_screen_blur_draw
comment: While lifetime+52 nonzero bind own render environment+44,initialize transform from scale+60/turn+64 and packedcolour+68 with alpha doubled and capped255,draw and restore previous context.

name: fighter_surface_run_effects
comment: Running dust (0x0897125C, effect catalog entry 0x3F) on 90B0C0/3060/606060/5000; on water a splash and ripples.

name: field_clamp_section_extremes
comment: bg_clamp_to_section_extremes through the field's background (+0x70); 1 without one.

name: field_floor_profile
comment: bg_floor_profile through the field's background.

name: field_player_placement
comment: Slot n starts at DMY_pp(n+1)_010 (background +0x600 + 0x10 n), in the section holding it (0x088E7864); on battle scenes even slots face +pi/2, odd -pi/2.

name: field_project_position
comment: NA2's stage_project_position: rejects a section outside 0..count-1 (+0x74), else bg_resolve_section_transfer.

name: stage_is_mission_scene
comment: 1 for scenes 13..41 (r001..r029, Master Road missions), 0 below 13; -1 argument reads the active scene.

name: mission_stage_load_auxiliary_archives
comment: For mission scenes loads gim.ccs and 13adv e000/e007/e300 and the mission's object resources.

name: fighter_surface_thud
type: void fighter_surface_thud(unsigned int surface, float *position, int hard)
comment: Mask F0F0F0. 202020 plays48 note32; water E0E090/E0A000/E0E000 plays48;60C0 plays3B;8080F0/5000/80D0F0/606060/90B0C0/3060 plays45 if hard,47 otherwise; other codes silent. Called at primary presentation event0 for damage actions44/45/4A(side surface C50,position+half height),46(ceiling C5C,position+height), and damage feedback helpers.

name: fighter_play_action_sfx
comment: Plays action_sfx_map[index] at the fighter; index 0xC on character 0x11 adds 0x1008.

name: fighter_footstep_tick
comment: Every n timeline updates (n by character, 0x089BC56C) plays the footstep for the fighter's surface.

name: fighter_schedule_action_audio
comment: NA2's fighter_schedule_action_audio: guard, jump, response and action sounds by major state; walk/run (major 1, 0x0E/0x12) footsteps every character period.

name: fighter_damage_surface_feedback
type: void fighter_damage_surface_feedback(void *fighter, int kind, int with_sound)
comment: Spawn ground feedback at fighter+40 from surface+C54, kind -1 selects basic feedback, otherwise scaled feedback(kind,1); with_sound calls fighter_surface_thud(surface,position,kind!=-1). fighter_present_action_effects uses secondary event0: animation slot1D/20 kind-1, slot21 kind2. Also called by character-specific presentation.

name: fighter_damage_surface_feedback_alternate
comment: Same surface feedback and optional thud as fighter_damage_surface_feedback; sole caller at089F2340.

name: fighter_present_action_effects
comment: NA2's fighter_present_action_effects with knockdown, bounce and damage-state landing effects and surface thuds; run dust and landings.

name: fighter_damage_feedback_suppressed
comment: For identities3B/40 return flag byte74 bit1. For identity64(hex) return that flag except major6/action60 and major5/actions38..3B,3E..4B,53..5A,5C, which return0. Other identities return0. Common fighter presenter suppresses secondary damage-surface feedback when true.

name: fighter_place_pair_at_safe_position
comment: Places a paired action's two fighters side by side at DMY_safe_pos on section 0.

name: fighter_correct_position
comment: NA2's stage_correct_position: mask 0x10 clamps x by field_clamp_section_extremes; mask 0x20 lifts to the floor profile as NA2's.

name: stage_get_default_bgm_member
comment: Scene's default track for scenes 0..41, else -1.

name: footstep_note_for_character
comment: 0x3A for characters 4/0x0E/0x15/0x51, 0x3B for 0x18, 0x39 for 0x32, else 0x3C, as NA2's.

name: fighter_play_footstep
comment: Plays footstep_sound_for_surface at the character's note; characters 0x15 and 0x53 add sound 0x2F.

name: sound_row
comment: A sound's six-byte row: bank 0 rows at 0x08C714A0 (0..0x77), bank 1 at 0x08C71770 (0x1000..0x1028), bank 2 at 0x08C71868 (0x2000..0x2064); null otherwise.

name: sound_play
comment: Plays a sound centred at its row's maximum volume and note.

name: sound_play_at
comment: Plays a sound at a position: distance volume (0x08A8E144) capped at the row's maximum, pan by direction, the row's note.

name: sound_play_at_note
comment: sound_play_at with the given note instead of the row's (0..0x7F).

name: sound_queue_note
comment: Queues a note-on: bank, program, volume, pan, note, sound id; up to seven per update.

name: sound_queue_flush
comment: Plays the queued note-ons through 0x08826358 (each tone of the program whose key range holds the note).

name: stage_camera_marker_defaults
comment: Eye min/max and target min/max used when the archive lacks DMY_cpmin/cpmax/cvmin/cvmax.

name: crash_break_reborn_responses
comment: Time-bomb hit responses 0x12,0x14,0x10,0x11,0x0B,0x0C,0x0D,0x0E, chosen by random(7).

name: time_bomb_blur_parameters
comment: ccEffectBlur parameter record used by bg_crash_break_reborn_blast: type6,kind0,scale1.1,turn0,colour50808080,duration20,phase0,phase_increment pi/16,follow values1/1. Configure copies record+1C to runtime+5C; runtime+64 rotation comes from record+0C (zero), not record+1C. Kind0 does not use the phase increment.

name: stage_select_records
comment: Stage Select rows: scene, name frame, big and small picture objects; order 0,6,7,8,1,4,5,3,12,11,2,10,9.

name: stage_name_text_ids
comment: Scene name text entries in 01text/text_*.bin: 160..199, then 181/182 again for r028/r029.

name: stage_archive_names
comment: Scene-indexed stage archive names: s01..s10,s13,s21,s22 (scenes 0..12), then r001..r029 (Master Road missions 13..41).

name: bg_record_factories
comment: BIN_bgdata factory table; NA2's numbering plus 134 ccBgCrashBreakRebornBattle, 135 flicker object, 139 ccBgFogCtrl, 151.

name: action_descriptor_table
comment: Eight-byte rows by substate: action name, descriptor; ACT_NUT_0 first; ACT_DMG_NSH 0x29 and ACT_DMG_SSF 0x44, two above NA2's (BTL 0x0089AEB0).

name: action_sfx_map
comment: UNH3's action sound numbers by NA2's action_sfx_map index.

name: sound_rows_commse0
comment: Six-byte rows of bank 0's sounds 0..0x77: program, note (0x40), maximum volume, three flags.

name: stage_default_bgm_members
comment: Default sound/bgm.afs member per scene.

name: sound_banks
comment: Sound bank files, 16 bytes each (kind, name, .phd size, .pbd size): 0 sound/se/commse0, 1 battleSE, 2 eventSE, then PL57.. character banks; a sound's high hex digit picks the bank.

name: stage_render_packet_coefficient
comment: Factory 17's second token; bss, set by no battle setup, so a stage without the record keeps the last one's (0 before any).

name: stage_render_colour_coefficient
comment: Factory 17's first token; bss, set by no battle setup, so a stage without the record keeps the last one's (0 before any). Draw passes override it only around their draw.

name: ai_controllers
comment: Four computer-fighter controllers of 0x240 bytes, one per manager fighter slot (+0x32C); +0x1C4 state, +0x1C8 next state, +0x1CC state timer, +0x1C0 target entry.
